top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver needs six hours of annual training in management techniques, leadership, or staff supervision.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four children's files evaluated lacked an address for the emergency contact.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The electrical outlets in the areas where children are cared have no proof covers.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.
